page_title: LEC 0-1 UDI | Lecce v Udinese 21/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Medon Berisha (Lecce) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frederic Guilbert trots off the pitch and is replaced by Danilo Veiga (Lecce).

87' Arthur Atta (Udinese) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.

86' Martin Payero (Udinese) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
86' Poor challenge! Ante Rebic (Lecce) is penalised for tripping and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Udinese will take a free kick near the side line.
83' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
82' Substitution. Tete Morente did his best and is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
80' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
77' Today's match ends for Thomas Kristensen who will be replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
77' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp will be replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) will replace Sandi Lovric.
77' Iker Bravo (Udinese) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Kevin Bonacina who sees an offensive foul.
74' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.
73' The resulting corner from Medon Berisha (Lecce) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.

72' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
72' Substitution. Balthazar Pierret is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
70' Rough tackle by Martin Payero (Udinese). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
67' Kevin Bonacina shows a yellow card to Martin Payero (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
66' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
65' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Payero (Udinese) replacing Alexis Sanchez.
64' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is about to take a corner kick.
64' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) takes the corner with a short pass.
63' Lecce spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The linesman makes the right call and Lecce will have a corner.
62' The corner from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
61' Neat link-up play between Tete Morente (Lecce) and Lassana Coulibaly, but Razvan Sava reads the game well and the move breaks down. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
60' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
60' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
59' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
58' Flag goes up against Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) leaps highest to meet a cross and steers a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a crucial save to thwart the effort.
56' Udinese fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.

55' Wladimiro Falcone leaps like a salmon to deny Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. Udinese will take a corner kick.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.

53' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Iker Bravo (Udinese) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
52' A cross from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
51' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
49' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is replaced by Medon Berisha.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Giampaolo gives a chance to Jesper Karlsson and Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but he misdirected his long-range shot as it went a few yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Kevin Bonacina interrupts the game. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
44' Now Udinese have a corner.
43' Tete Morente (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
42' Tete Morente (Lecce) commits a foul and Kevin Bonacina immediately signals a free kick.
40' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
38' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.
36' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lorenzo Lucca walks off the pitch to be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wladimiro Falcone into the top left corner.
31' That's a clear yellow card. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) goes into the book.
31' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Udinese!
28' Referee Kevin Bonacina makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
27' PENALTY APPEAL after Sandi Lovric (Udinese) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
26' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
26' Decent spell from Lecce here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Lecce earn a corner.
26' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Lecce have a corner.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
24' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) sends a long ball in, but Wladimiro Falcone comfortably gathers the ball.
21' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
18' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
16' The ball is behind the sideline. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes a throw-in.
13' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a throw-in.
11' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
10' Udinese take a short corner kick.

8' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Udinese will take a throw-in.
7' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Kevin Bonacina has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

6' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off an easy save.
4' The foul by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was seen by Kevin Bonacina who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' The ball goes wide of the goal and out for a goal kick. It looks like Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) is going to take it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will supervise the game today.
